lessons.title: Ascend draft capture loses DecodeOnly when upstream adds a new metadata entry point
lessons.symptom: Deepseek MTP spec-decode E2E fails on FULL decode-only/profile graphs at draft graph replay: `aclnnFusedInferAttentionScoreV4 failed, error code is 561002` with `actualSeqLengthsQ[1](2) is larger than Q_S(1)`. Traceback: autoregressive/speculator.py::_multi_step_decode -> aclgraph.run_fullgraph -> _graph_replay -> mla_v1.update_graph_params. Overriding _build_draft_attn_metadata alone does not fix it.
lessons.root_cause: vLLM #56181 replaced Speculator._build_draft_attn_metadata with _build_attn_metadata/_build_uniform_attn_metadata. The Ascend speculator only overrode the old name. During graph capture, AscendAutoRegressiveSpeculator.capture() passes self._multi_step_decode as the capture forward_fn, and upstream _multi_step_decode now builds metadata via self._build_uniform_attn_metadata — which Ascend does not override — so the captured draft graph is built without the forced AscendAttentionState.DecodeOnly. MLA forward_decode then takes its non-spec branch (input_layout BNSD_NBSD, Q_S==1), while replay still feeds the cumulative FIA actual_seq_lengths_q ([1,2,...]) from _update_decode_attn_metadata, failing the tiling check.
fix_guidance: Find the new upstream metadata entry point name (e.g. _build_uniform_attn_metadata) and override it on the Ascend speculator too, not just the old method.

In the override, reproduce upstream's batch-descriptor token semantics: num_reqs_padded = batch_desc.num_reqs or num_reqs; num_tokens_padded = batch_desc.num_tokens when batch_desc.cg_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL else int(query_start_loc_np[-1]); query_start_loc_np = arange(num_reqs+1) * num_query_per_req.
Forward to the existing Ascend builder so the forced DecodeOnly attn_state and build_draft_attn_metadata_factory wrapping still apply during capture.
Add any extra passthrough params (e.g. dcp_local_seq_lens) to the Ascend builder and its release super call.
Verify release-lane safety: v0.29.0 has no _build_uniform_attn_metadata, so its capture still reaches the overridden _build_draft_attn_metadata; the new override is dead code there.
